subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Turn the held toy car until its hood faces left, then set it lengthwise inside the box beside the toothbrush.
Pack the shoe lengthwise in the back of the box behind the car, with its toe pointing left and heel pointing right.
Pack the hammer lengthwise just behind the toy car, with its metal head pointing left and its yellow handle pointing right. Leave the back row for the shoe.
Return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open, staying clear of the packed box.
